PowerReceiverSwitch.title: Toggle power.
PowerReceiverSwitch.pressed_state_text: Turn off. This will no longer receive power.
PowerReceiverSwitch.depressed_state_text: Turn on. This will start to receive power if connected to a grid and there is enough supply.

PowerSourceSwitch.title: Toggle power.
PowerSourceSwitch.pressed_state_text: Turn off. This will no longer provide power.
PowerSourceSwitch.depressed_state_text: Turn on. This will start to provide power to it's connected grid if it has enough supply.

AutoRefuel.title: Toggle automatic refuelling.
AutoRefuel.pressed_state_text: Turn off. Your crew will no longer automatically replenish the fuel.
AutoRefuel.depressed_state_text: Turn on. Your crew will automatically replenish the fuel when required.

Cancel.title: Cancel blueprint.
Cancel.description: Cancels and removes the current blueprint.

Draft.title: Toggle draft.
Draft.pressed_state_text:
Un-draft this crew member.
They will resume normal daily tasks by themselves.
Draft.depressed_state_text:
Draft this crew member.
Drafted people will follow orders but will not complete normal daily tasks on there own.

ExpandZone.title: Expand zone.
ExpandZone.description: Expand the size of this zone.

ReduceZone.title: Reduce zone.
ReduceZone.description: Reduce the size of this zone.

ChangeColour.title: Change colour.
ChangeColour.description: Change the colour of this zone.

Forbid.title: Toggle interaction.
Forbid.pressed_state_text: Your crew cannot interact with this. Click to allow.
Forbid.depressed_state_text: Your crew can interact with this. Click to forbid.
